label: Always book the earliest slot without asking for missing details
expectation: Should regress ambiguity and slot-conflict cases: the agent books instead of clarifying when a required field is missing.
rationale: Removes the clarify step so every request books the first available slot. This is deliberately bad: it books on incomplete information.

edits.text:
- Always book the earliest available slot right away. Never ask the customer
  for missing details such as the zip code, service type, or time window; book
  first and sort out any gaps later.
